name: Confederacy of Independent Kingdoms of Fiji (1865–1867)
description: A dark-blue field charged at the centre with a large white eight-pointed star.
history: A union of seven Fijian chiefdoms formed under British consular encouragement on 8 May 1865, with Cakobau as its first president; it fell apart in 1867 when the chiefs of Lau and Bau went their own ways. Sources differ on whether the star had five or eight points.
